newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Paranagua/Santos sugar shipping conditions.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Paranagua/Santos sugar shipping conditions.

text.p: The Brazilian ports of Paranagua and Santos reported the following conditions for shipping sugar.
Vessels: Southway loading 15,138 tonnes using big bags. Waiting to dock, seven vessels to load using big bags and two to load bulk.
Road: 111 trucks carrying sugar arrived on June 10.
Loading: 1,801 tonnes sugar using big bags.

Vessels: Araya loading 35,200 tonnes bulk sugar, Symplea loading 13,000 tonnes bagged sugar, Cormorant, Unisea, Qing Jiang, Fulvia and Daiana P each loading 14,000 tonnes bagged sugar. Waiting to dock, three vessels to load bagged sugar and three to load bulk. At Cargill private terminal, Ya Latif loading 25,000 tonnes bulk sugar. Waiting to dock,
